Club: Swimming.description:
🏊 You are a member of the U.A. Swimming club.

🗓️ It meets before homeroom on Wednesday, in the Indoor Pool.
🤝 Tsuyu Asui runs it; Thirteen is the advisor.
📈 Grants: Swimming +5. Practice counts as training.

Say "I quit the club" to leave it.
Club: Swimming.traitNarrativeEffects: The character is a member of the U.A. Swimming club, run by Tsuyu Asui with Thirteen as advisor; it meets before homeroom on Wednesday in the Indoor Pool. The lead and members know they are a member (never ask them to sign up again). Going to practice is the player's choice each time; a missed practice is fine, a habit of missing gets one honest word from the lead. Club time is real time: an afternoon at the club is an afternoon not spent elsewhere.
